title: TAI exact-main controller authority selection repair
objective: Select the newest exact-main full-stack release whose contract and production deployment jobs both completed successfully, so a newer workflow-level success with a skipped deployment job cannot shadow valid deployment authority and block the bounded root controller synchronization.
boundaries: The only command is /tai sync-controller current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
Candidate runs must match exact current main, main branch, repository identity, allowed event, completed status and successful workflow conclusion
The selected authority must additionally contain exactly one successful Validate full-stack release contract job and exactly one successful Migrate, deploy API and web, verify live intake job
A newer workflow-level success with a skipped or failed deployment job must be rejected without shadowing an older exact-main run whose required jobs passed
No controller, VPS, runner, database, model or application mutation occurs until valid job-level full-stack authority is selected
Transport reuses the canonical REG.RU host, protected root SSH principal, normalized private key and pinned host fingerprint
The uploaded wrapper must be byte-identical to scripts/pc-tai-release-controller.sh in the protected production repository at exact current main
The shared /run/lock/pc-tai-release-controller.lock must be held before protected checkout and throughout synchronization
The existing sudoControllerSha256 marker must equal the installed controller digest before any mutation
Only /usr/local/sbin/pc-tai-release-controller and sudoControllerSha256 in the existing runner authority marker may change
Controller and marker are replaced with atomic renames, fsynced and post-verified
Previous controller and marker are restored and fsynced on any failure after mutation begins
An already exact and correctly attested controller is an idempotent no-mutation PASS
The installed controller remains root:pcactions mode 0750 and sudoers remains restricted to that single path
The self-hosted runner remains non-root, outside the docker group and without direct Docker access
No runner registration or service restart, Compose, database, model or application deployment mutation occurs
No model, tenant, application role, financial or autonomous write authority is widened
The accepted canonical image trigger scope remains unchanged
No new recurring cost
